blocked.reason: Only the normalized record and supplied catalog fields are available; the referenced source file body is not in this attempt workspace.
blocked.unblock_condition: An authorized ingestion job supplies the exact source body at the recorded commit and verifies its hash and license.

blocked.reason: A URL is known, but page contents, redirects, authorship, version, license, and availability were not checked.
blocked.unblock_condition: An authorized retrieval job captures and validates the public page with provenance.

blocked.reason: The record claims an official assignment category but supplies no assignment title, term, prompt, URL, or file.
blocked.unblock_condition: A validated official source supplies a specific assignment artifact and term/version metadata.

blocked.reason: Only the catalog-provided repository URL is present; repository contents and rights were not inspected.

rules: Do not infer material availability from a title, URL, raw catalog description, or official-course-unit flag.
Do not fetch access-controlled, sealed, private, credentialed, hidden-grader, or otherwise restricted content.
A later job may retrieve an explicitly recorded public locator only when that job is authorized for network retrieval.
Store retrieved artifacts outside student views until provenance, authorship, license, integrity, and learner-release status are classified.
Record the requested locator, resolved locator, pinned version or retrieval time, content hash, license evidence, and retrieval result.
A failed retrieval remains durable evidence and must not be relabeled as available.
Promoting a resource record to a course unit requires an explicit reviewed decision; retrieval alone is insufficient.
Never copy examiner guidance, hidden validation data, or another learner's files into student_safe/.
later_expansion_gate: The material artifact is actually present.
Its identity and relationship to the cataloged course are verified.
Its use and learner visibility are permitted.
Its provenance and validation label are recorded.
Any new unit is bounded and receives its own completion policy.
retrieval_policy.fallback: If a source remains unavailable, author a clearly labeled self-contained substitute or defer the topic; never imply that missing official content was used.
